mapper.select: SELECT id, pilot_id, content, is_checked, image_url, image_filename, order_num, created_at FROM pilot_checklists WHERE pilot_id = #{pilotId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pilot_checklists (pilot_id, content, is_checked, image_url, image_filename, order_num) VALUES (#{pilotId}, #{content}, FALSE, #{imageUrl}, #{imageFilename}, #{orderNum})
mapper.update: UPDATE pilot_checklists SET content = #{content}, is_checked = #{isChecked}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, image_filename = #{imageFilename}, order_num = #{orderNum} WHERE id = #{id}
